title: charts: count measures get fractional y-axis ticks (0.5, 0.8, 1.5 …)
body:
Path: ② the capabilities an end user meets in the app — dashboards and charts | 缺项 | P2

Split by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` from objectui#11672 (the 2026-10-06 console dogfood sweep, showcase, framework `ce577ec4`), item 9. Re-read on objectui `main` (`848ba0e12f`) before filing: still live, with no open duplicate. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` (about `:2818`–`:2845`) and `ChartImpl.tsx` (about `:105`) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: no axis declares integer ticks for an integer measure.

## What happens

"Projects by Health" shows 0.8 / 1.5 / 2.3 / 3, "Tasks by Status" 0.5 steps, and "Invoices by Month" 0.8 … 3, as do Chart Gallery's charts. No chart sets `allowDecimals`.

## Done when

- A count measure, or any integer-typed measure, gets integer ticks. Non-integer measures are unchanged.
- **Pin:** the measured charts render integer ticks, and a sum over currency keeps its decimals.
